  • Method Details

    • calculateSimilarity

      public double calculateSimilarity(HandwritingGraph graph1, HandwritingGraph graph2)
      Calculates similarity between two graphs using both node values and edge weights. The contribution of nodes vs edges is determined dynamically based on how many of each exist in the graph — no hardcoded split ratio. finalScore = nodeRatio * nodeSimilarity + edgeRatio * edgeSimilarity where nodeRatio = nodeCount / (nodeCount + edgeCount)
      Parameters:
      graph1 - first handwriting graph
      graph2 - second handwriting graph
      Returns:
      similarity score between 0 and 1 (1 = identical)

    • findBestMatch

      public GraphSimilarity.MatchResult findBestMatch(HandwritingGraph suspectGraph, HandwritingGraph[] studentGraphs, String[] studentNames, String[] studentIds)
      Finds the best matching student for a suspect graph
      Parameters:
      suspectGraph - the graph to match
      studentGraphs - array of known student graphs
      studentNames - array of corresponding student names
      Returns:
      the ID of the best matching student
